ns2:course.label: Discrete Event Dynamic Systems
ns2:course.description: Introduction to modeling, analysis, control, and performance evaluation of discrete event dynamic systems (DEDS), characterized by state changes only at discrete points in time in response to the occurrence of particular events and which therefore may have logical or symbolic values rather than numerical ones. Discrete-state/discrete/event models decidability, computational issues, forbidden-state problems, forbidden-string problems, enforcing safety and liveness properties via supervision, generalized semi-Markov processes, sensitivity analysis via likelihood ratio and infinitesimal perturbation methods. Prerequisite: CS 173 or MATH 213; CS 225; MATH 415; MATH 461.
